title_en: New Slang, New Stories (11/20): "City or Not City?" on the Mall Rooftop
note_en: "city不city" borrows the Chinese A-not-A question, where you ask by putting a word next to its negative: 好不好 "good or not?", 去不去 "going or not?" Here an English word fills the slot, as in 上海city不city？ "Is Shanghai city or not?" The answer drops the 不 and just repeats the word with 很 or 好: 好city啊！ "So city!"
